name: schwab_readpath_no_baseline_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: SCHWAB_READPATH_NO_BASELINE_20261103 — an empty/corrupt holdings store is 'no snapshot' to the Schwab sync READ diff (never a JSONDecodeError), while a WRITE still resolves the restored candidate or a backup as its baseline so the coverage/cash/catastrophic-drop guards stay live and a write that drops a non-synced account is refused.
